# Wheeler Hubbell Publishing (WHP)

> A decision-integrity protocol and operating service that evaluates whether submitted claims and requested operations are warranted by their source, provenance, authority, conditions, and limits. This file is a navigation aid, not a universal instruction or proof of runtime behavior.

## Governing source and verification

- Governing text: [Decision Integrity: The Continuous Work](https://wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/essay.html). It governs passage, not reality itself; it requires each claim and transition to remain answerable to its record and warrant.
- Live service contract: [GET /v1/contract](https://api.wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/v1/contract). Read it at time of use for current schemas, payment terms, signatures, limitations, and verification procedure. Do not substitute this summary for the live contract.
- Runtime discovery: [WHP Standing discovery](https://api.wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/.well-known/whp-standing.json).
- Public hub: https://wheelerhubbellpublishing.com
- Announcement: [The Standing Mark is live - October 30, 2026](https://wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/press/the-standing-mark-is-live.html). Dated public announcement of the live service; release document at [/press/standing-mark-press-release.pdf](https://wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/press/standing-mark-press-release.pdf).

## Four connected repositories

1. [standing-guard-service](https://github.com/wheelerhubbell/standing-guard-service) — deployed runtime host and service integration. Its current `AGENTS.md` distinguishes the ordinary `/v1/evaluate` front door from the sealed runtime routed through `/v1/evaluations`; follow that distinction.
2. [standing-gate](https://github.com/wheelerhubbell/standing-gate) — CI/action enforcement; `gate-check.cjs` defaults to `/v1/evaluate`.
3. [whp-sentinel-template](https://github.com/wheelerhubbell/whp-sentinel-template) — CI workflow integrating `standing-gate@v0`.
4. [wheelerhubbell.github.io](https://github.com/wheelerhubbell/wheelerhubbell.github.io) — public documentation and discovery.

A leaf cannot define the whole. Trace the exact request through the workflow, gate, selected endpoint, runtime handler, signed response, and verification path. Keep claims bounded to the evidence collected; a live HTTP response does not by itself prove a completed payment, subscription fulfillment, or every customer journey.

## Do not conflate the service doors

- `POST /v1/evaluate` is the ordinary-agent evaluation path. The gate defaults to it; its structural evaluation record is distinct from the sealed WHP Standing Mark. Consult current repository code and the response format before describing authentication or outcomes.
- `POST /v1/evaluations` is the sealed WHP Standing path documented by the live contract. The contract currently describes a 1 USDC exact x402 Base purchase, exact quote binding, finalized-transfer verification before issuance, and result recovery. Negative assessments do not become Standing Marks; payment buys evaluation, not a favorable result. Re-read the live contract rather than treating these details in this file as immutable.
- The Base settlement address is `0x1050eddd8282623b0c263ed6bdbd42370bbc28d3`; the USDC contract on Base is `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`. A direct transfer to that address alone is not evidence of a service purchase, credit balance, subscription, or API-key provisioning. The live contract does not define tier-pack fulfillment; do not claim it exists unless an implemented and verified path proves it.
- The current public key, contract hash, schemas, and supported outcomes must be taken from live discovery/contract responses. Do not treat a key copied into a document as proof of current issuance or successful verification.

## Protocol boundaries

The protocol preserves object identity, source, assertion, requested operation, authority, jurisdiction, temporal validity, qualifiers, relations, and lawful unknowns. It names failures including Authority Leakage, Coherent Substitution, Object Drift, Qualifier Stripping, and Answer to the Wrong Question. It does not make every uncertainty disappear or authorize more than the record warrants.

This file and `llms.txt` are optional discovery aids. No external AI platform is required to fetch, retain, or obey them; they cannot create universal memory or bind unrelated systems. Repository instructions likewise guide tools that read them, but cannot guarantee behavior by every person, model, crawler, or client.

- Verification: https://api.wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/v1/verification
- MCP: https://api.wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/mcp
## Successive examinations and continuity

- `POST /v1/evaluate` accepts `prior_record_hash` and an optional `continuity` object as request fields. Their presence does not, by itself, authenticate a predecessor, establish lineage, prove that earlier records were preserved, or show that a prior unknown was resolved.
- Standing Gate can pass predecessor fields through and report what the returned evaluator record states. Treat continuity as established only when an authenticated, independently verifiable service record supports the relationship.
- The live contract and discovery document describe the current service boundary. Do not claim verified successive-examination continuity from request fields, client reports, mock fixtures, or unit tests alone.
